sourceReasoning: The actual change moves the sole direct component Date.now call into a layout effect and stores only the current predicate identity and observation time. Render itself does not hide a fresh clock in a new helper.

A snapshot is usable only for the exact current predicate and literal true result. Loading and scoped OpenCode readiness retain their original short circuits; unrelated provider fallback, chip selection and rendering are byte-preserved.

The actual sole caller receives a fresh permits function on parent renders. The unchanged owner expiry+1 timer invalidates that parent. A child-only update does not recreate its parent prop; no new timer or provider/authority policy is introduced.

The appended regression forces providerStates recomputation through a fresh equivalent child loading object while retaining parent predicate identity. A delegating spy proves at least one real predicate call with the original observation time; the prior render-time clock implementation cannot satisfy that assertion at+250ms.

The guard uses the actual readiness object separately from the presentation spy. Exact expiry blocks actions before the original+1 callback; advancing that last millisecond triggers the real owner and removes Ready without another explicit parent render.

Every original body is an exact contiguous prefix after imports, including all nine captured-scope variants, sibling isolation and original guard/global-object assertions. No mock or store mutation is added.

StrictMode may replay effect setup in development; this cut does not promise a global once-only clock count. Existing set-state-in-effect is warning-level. Runtime, compiler/lint, and resulting Team/Desktop success remain unqualified.
